audience: HR teams who manage people, jobs, leave and training in intelliHR

useCases.title: See who is on extended leave right now
useCases.text: The AI lists people who are on extended leave, with name, employee number, employment status and jobs.

useCases.title: Find jobs that end soon
useCases.text: The AI lists jobs by status or upcoming end date, with person, position title, location, supervisor and dates. It can read the timeline of one job.

useCases.title: Review the tasks of a person by tab
useCases.text: The AI finds a person and lists their tasks, such as forms, reviews and onboarding steps, by tab: due, done, about me or about others.

useCases.title: Review skills, qualifications and training
useCases.text: The AI lists the skills of a person, the qualifications people hold (licences, certificates) and the training records with provider and dates.

useCases.title: Add a person or update a person's record
useCases.text: The AI checks for a duplicate, then creates a person, or changes names, employee number or emergency contact. No job or user account is created.

useCases.title: Record extended leave on a job
useCases.text: The AI finds the job and the leave type, then records extended leave such as parental or long service leave with the end date you give.
